title: Istio Egress
description: Egress gateway traffic and blocked outbound observations. REGISTRY_ONLY block_all responses occur in application sidecars; choose their namespace to inspect them. HTTP 443 registration alone does not route HTTPS through the gateway.

panels.title: Egress gateway HTTP requests by host and status

targets.expr: sum by (authority, namespace) (count_over_time({job="integrations/istio",container="istio-proxy",log_type="access",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} | pattern `<_> "<method> <path> <protocol>" <status_code> <response_flags> <response_code_details> <connection_termination_details> "<failure_reason>" <bytes_received> <bytes_sent> <duration> <upstream_time> "<forward_for>" "<agent>" "<req_id>" "<authority>" "<upstream_host>" <upstream_cluster> <upstream_local_address> <downstream_local_address> <downstream_remote_address> <requested_server_name> <route_name> traceID=<trace_id>` | __error__="" | route_name="block_all" [$__interval]))

sum by (response_flags, response_code_details) (count_over_time({job="integrations/istio",container="istio-proxy",log_type="access",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} | pattern `<_> "<method> <path> <protocol>" <status_code> <response_flags> <response_code_details> <connection_termination_details> "<failure_reason>" <bytes_received> <bytes_sent> <duration> <upstream_time> "<forward_for>" "<agent>" "<req_id>" "<authority>" "<upstream_host>" <upstream_cluster> <upstream_local_address> <downstream_local_address> <downstream_remote_address> <requested_server_name> <route_name> traceID=<trace_id>` | __error__="" | response_flags!="-" [$__interval]))

{job="integrations/istio",container="istio-proxy",log_type="access",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} | pattern `<_> "<method> <path> <protocol>" <status_code> <response_flags> <response_code_details> <connection_termination_details> "<failure_reason>" <bytes_received> <bytes_sent> <duration> <upstream_time> "<forward_for>" "<agent>" "<req_id>" "<authority>" "<upstream_host>" <upstream_cluster> <upstream_local_address> <downstream_local_address> <downstream_remote_address> <requested_server_name> <route_name> traceID=<trace_id>` | __error__="" | route_name="block_all" or pod=~".*egressgateway.*" | line_format `{{.method}} {{.authority}}{{.path}} status={{.status_code}} flags={{.response_flags}} details={{.response_code_details}} route={{.route_name}} traceID={{.trace_id}}`
